    def test_native_frozen_tab_logout(playwright, named, request):
        """Native Chromium suspension, distinct from authenticated BFCache admission."""
        browser = playwright.chromium.launch(channel="chromium")
        context = browser.new_context(ignore_https_errors=True, proxy=named["proxy"])
        evidence = NativeEvidence(context, request.node.nodeid)
        try:
            a = open_page(context, named)
            login(a)
            a.locator("#single-space").select_option("research")
            expect(a.locator("#index-status")).to_contain_text("research: disabled")
            b = open_page(context, named)
            expect(b.locator("#index-status")).to_contain_text("default: disabled")
            a.evaluate("""() => {
              window.nativeSuspension=[];
              for (const type of ['freeze','resume'])
                document.addEventListener(type, () => nativeSuspension.push(type));
            }""")
            cdp = context.new_cdp_session(a)
            cdp.send("Page.setWebLifecycleState", {"state": "frozen"})
            evidence.record("native-freeze-command-completed")
            b.get_by_role("button", name="Log out", exact=True).click()
            expect(b.locator("#session-message")).to_contain_text("removal confirmed")
            assert not session_cookie(context)
            start = len(named["inventory"])
            cdp.send("Page.setWebLifecycleState", {"state": "active"})
            a.bring_to_front()
            # A missed storage notification can conservatively leave this old page
            # logout_pending even though the other tab settled the shared journal.
            # ADR 0011 permits this locked state; it must never auto-replay a DELETE.
            expect(a.locator("#session-message")).to_contain_text("Page locked; session removal not confirmed")
            expect(a.locator("#unlock-form")).to_be_hidden()
            expect(a.locator("#spaces")).to_be_hidden()
            expect(a.locator("#single-space")).to_have_value("")
            expect(a.locator("#index-status")).to_be_empty()
